During the period 2022 - 2025, Winrock implemented Phase I of the Solarizing Community Water Supply project, which demonstrated the lease-to-own model in ten communities in Amhara and Oromia regional states. title: Project Director

The Project Director serves as the principal representative of the project portfolio and is accountable for successful delivery of program results, achievement of performance milestones, financial stewardship, compliance with donor requirements, and effective partnership with the Government of Ethiopia. The Project Director will oversee implementation of two complementary HRH initiatives under a unified leadership structure. The first builds on the implementation platforms and partnerships established under the former RISE Maternal, Newborn, Child Health, and Nutrition (MNCHN) Ethiopia project, with its technical focus strategically transitioned toward a comprehensive HRH systems strengthening. The second is ASCEND, a performance-based activity, which expands technical support to additional HRH priorities, institutions, and implementation areas. Together, these initiatives require integrated technical planning, harmonized implementation approaches, coordinated quality assurance, adaptive learning, and continuous technical oversight to maximize impact while maintaining accountability to each award's distinct objectives. The portfolio will primarily support fragile, underserved, and workforce-constrained settings, where shortages of competent health professionals, weak institutional capacity, limited leadership and governance systems, and inadequate workforce management continue to constrain delivery of quality health services. Working closely with the Technical Director, the Project Director will ensure that both projects function as one integrated HRH systems strengthening portfolio that delivers measurable improvements in workforce competency, workforce performance, institutional capacity, organizational leadership, health service quality, health system resilience, and sustainable country ownership.
